meta.note: Neutrals, radii and shadows are the shipping bobble flavor's exact values; the cursor, its blue, its glide and press are agent-cursor.ts's; the slide is the mark loader's. The three hues are the mark's own tile colours (bobble-tiles.ts before 13028e18). The display face, the hue tints and inks, and the picture and demo tokens are new with this language.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window and page behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid surfaces that hold work: cards, the reading column, illustration frames.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells and insets: code blocks inside a card, a track, an empty slot.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Frosted chrome: menus, sheets, popovers. 95% so the blur behind still reads.

tokens.name: sidebar-glass
tokens.usage: The sidebar's glass over the window.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, surface and overlay (15:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: process rows, captions under a demo, metadata that is read (6.8:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet text: timestamps, placeholders, units, on ground, surface and surface-sunken (4.6:1 or more light, 6.5:1 dark). Replaces the shipping #86868b, which is 3.3:1 on ground.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a surface.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The edge of any floating or raised object: cards, frames, menus.

tokens.name: edge-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must read (3:1 against their ground): inputs, the pointer's rim.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Skeleton text in illustrations: the bars that stand for words.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: A skeleton line that is selected, active or a heading.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Mark hue for words and numbers: docs, sheets, mail, the calendar, charts. Tiles, bars, marked cells and selection in a picture. Never text; text on it is on-hue.

tokens.name: teal-tint
tokens.usage: A teal wash: picture plates, the selection behind skeleton lines, a hue tile's ground.

tokens.name: teal-ink
tokens.usage: Teal text and glyphs on ground, surface and teal-tint (5:1 or more both themes).

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Mark hue for pictures and pages: images, designs, decks. The same roles as teal. Never text; text on it is on-hue.

tokens.name: sun-tint
tokens.usage: A sun wash, as teal-tint.

tokens.name: sun-ink
tokens.usage: Sun text and glyphs on ground, surface and sun-tint (5.3:1 or more).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Mark hue for things that move: video, animation, 3D. The same roles as teal. Never text; text on it is on-hue.

tokens.name: pink-tint
tokens.usage: A pink wash, as teal-tint: behind a video, a motion scene, a model.

tokens.name: pink-ink
tokens.usage: Pink text and glyphs on ground, surface and pink-tint (5.6:1 or more).

tokens.name: on-hue
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs ON a teal, sun or pink fill, in both themes. White on a hue fill fails contrast.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: The agent cursor's edge glow (AGENT_CURSOR_GLOW in packages/shared/src/agent-cursor.ts). Nothing but the agent's cursor and pill is this blue.

tokens.name: agent-pill
tokens.usage: The status pill beside Bobble's cursor (AGENT_PILL_FILL). on-agent text on it holds 4.6:1.

tokens.name: on-agent
tokens.usage: Text on the status pill, at 600 12px.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive colour: the primary button, the on state of a switch, a selected tab.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (5.7:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on every surface (5:1 or more).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, saved, passed. Always with a word or a glyph.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs a look. Shares the sun ink, always with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, will delete. Always with a word or a glyph; never decoration.

tokens.name: mark-ink
tokens.usage: The mark's tiles in UI: black on light, white on dark.

families.ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one big line of a screen that introduces something: onboarding, a studio's first view.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Screen titles where the page is about one thing: Extensions, a connector's detail.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: The title inside an illustration and the greeting above an empty composer.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: A small illustration's title, a demo card's heading.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: The deck is ready: eight slides, one job each.
styles.usage: The model's replies and anything meant to be read.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Runs Python inside the open Blender.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a title: what kind, where it lives, when.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels in the sidebar and over a group. Uppercase, ink-muted.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Illustrations are drawn on an 8px grid at their 1x size.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a pill between glyph and label; between a title and its caption.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; the illustration grid unit; the gap between a demo frame and its caption.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding; the gap between skeleton lines in a group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding at small sizes; between groups of controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and frame padding; between groups of skeleton lines.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Screen gutters at the widest; around a hero illustration.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between a screen's title block and its content.

radius.note: The shipping scale. Tiles in illustrations take radius-tile (the mark's 3.5 on 12.5).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small chips, a tag.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu rows; a mini tile under 24px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, illustration frames at 320px wide.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The composer, dialogs, sheets, a hero frame.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Every tile in an illustration and the mark: the corner is 28% of the side, at any size.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, dots, switches. In SVG use half the short side, not 9999.

shadow.note: Contact, cast and ambient layers: an object sits on something. Dark adds a lit top rim.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Tiles and chips that sit on a surface.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards and illustration frames.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The one lifted object in a scene: the frame a demo is about.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the floating pill in a demo.

tokens.name: shadow-agent-pill
tokens.usage: Under the agent's status pill, as the overlay draws it.

duration.note: The interface's own steps, then the beats a demo loop is built from.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Most state changes; menus opening.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Panels and cards changing size.

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: A dialog or sheet rising in.

tokens.name: duration-travel
tokens.usage: How long the cursor takes to glide to a target (AGENT_CURSOR_TRAVEL_MS); the press after it is 150ms.

tokens.name: duration-slide
tokens.usage: One beat of the mark's sliding-tile puzzle (global.css .pd-bobble-loader). A slide takes 0.4 of it; twelve beats bring every tile home.

tokens.name: duration-beat
tokens.usage: One move in a demo: the pointer travelling a short way, a part lifting, a line growing.

tokens.name: duration-hold
tokens.usage: How long a demo rests on its result before it starts again.

tokens.name: duration-loop
tokens.usage: The longest a demo loop may run, rest included.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity changes.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Anything arriving: sheets, a frame entering, a line growing. The Apple sheet curve.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Anything leaving.

tokens.name: ease-glide
tokens.usage: The cursor's glide (AGENT_CURSOR_EASE): quick away, a hair past, home. Pointer travel only.

tokens.name: ease-slide
tokens.usage: A tile sliding cell to cell, as the mark's puzzle does: quick out, firm in, no bounce, because a tile in a frame has nowhere to overshoot to.

tokens.name: ease-bob
tokens.usage: A tile or dot being PLACED: a mark landing on a day, a chip appearing. A small overshoot and back; tiles and dots only, never a slide.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Press and release.

easing.note: Seven curves, one per verb. A loop uses one verb; arrivals settle, travel glides, tiles slide, placed marks bob.
